strategy: After the 200-place milestone, growth is quality-led: add new countries/regions, replace weak quasi-live with true live where possible, and improve one-place countries before adding more density to already-rich markets.
priorities: Add genuinely new countries before increasing already-dense Japan/US/Austria coverage.
Upgrade one-place countries with a second useful view only when it represents a genuinely different destination.
Prefer true live/external-live upgrades for countries currently represented only by LIVE_IMAGE.
Keep quasi-live searchable but out of Watch Earth unless separately verified for continuous live playback.
Do not use business potential to decide source truth or featured ranking.
